name: 1,3-benzodioxolyl-N-ethylpentanamine
summary: EBDP, also known as N-ethyl-1,3-benzodioxolylpentanamine, 3,4-methylenedioxy-N-ethyl-α-propylphenethylamine, or ethyl-K, is a psychoactive drug of the phenethylamine, amphetamine, and MDxx families. It is the N-ethyl analogue of BDP (K).

sideEffects.en: Little is known about it in people. Drugs of its family, the MDxx compounds such as MDMA, can cause jaw clenching, a fast heartbeat, overheating, low blood sodium and, at worst, serotonin syndrome.
sideEffects.zh: 目前對它在人體的作用所知甚少。同族的MDxx類藥物（例如MDMA）可能造成咬牙、心跳加快、體溫過高、血鈉過低，嚴重時可能引發血清素症候群。
sideEffects.zhHans: 目前对它在人体的作用所知甚少。同族的MDxx类药物（例如MDMA）可能造成咬牙、心跳加快、体温过高、血钠过低，严重时可能引发血清素症候群。

fact.en: Alexander Shulgin listed it in PiHKAL as Ethyl-K, after the short letter code K that he used for its parent compound BDP.
fact.zh: Alexander Shulgin在《PiHKAL》中將它列為「Ethyl-K」，名稱來自他給母體化合物BDP的代號K。
fact.zhHans: Alexander Shulgin在《PiHKAL》中将它列为「Ethyl-K」，名称来自他给母体化合物BDP的代号K。
